base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())

        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `claim_run_dir` creates the record base and the new run directory with `mkdir` but never syncs the record base directory entry. Later `durable_write` syncs the receipt/run directory, not the parent `record_dir`, so a power loss can leave admission recorded while the new run directory entry (and its recovery state) is lost. The fix is to fsync the record base after creating `self.run_dir`, and fsync its parent if this invocation created it, failing closed if either sync fails.
